tara-sales: Quick sync — Prospect (LumenCo) wants SSO + SCIM + project-level RBAC; they asked about domain proofing, SCIM delta rate limits, and encryption of identity data. Can we confirm hosted vs private impacts on timeline and pricing?

sam-se: For Hosted API: SCIM v2 supported, default rate-limit 100 reqs/min per tenant (burst handled by queue). Dedicated can support higher sustained rates and MTLS for SCIM. Pricing note: provisioning events count toward identity API units — rough estimate 200k user-sync events/year -> may push them to Dedicated/Reserved quote.

jin-idx: They also want delegated admins and group-scoped roles. Our RBAC supports role namespaces and group->role mapping, but we need a mapping template to avoid drift. I can prep the template.

tara-sales: @jin-idx pls drop mapping template. Also security sent a questionnaire — two mandatory asks: customer-managed KMS for identity PII at rest, and SCIM over MTLS. Are those covered?

olga-sec: KMS (BYOK) is supported for Private deployments and Dedicated (Enterprise plan) via our KMS integrations. Hosted uses provider-managed keys by default; we offer BYOK for Enterprise customers after DPA + KMS attestation. MTLS for SCIM is only available on Dedicated/Private currently. Hosted supports TLS1.3 with mTLS not available.

sam-se: SAML support: SP-initiated & IdP-initiated flows supported. Assertion lifetime default 5m, and we can configure session binding for longer sessions on Dedicated. Domain verification: we support dns TXT or email-based domain proofing; for strict tenant-locking they should use DNS TXT + org-level claims.

jin-idx: I'll attach the mapping template and a sample SCIM header for MTLS in the POC repo. Example header snippet: 

jin-idx: ```
Authorization: Bearer <token>
X-MTLS-Client-Cert: <cert-fingerprint>
Content-Type: application/json
```

tara-sales: Timeline ask from AE: POC kickoff in 2 weeks (30 seats, full SCIM sync + SSO). Realistic?

olga-sec: For Dedicated POC with MTLS + BYOK KMS we need ~10 business days for infra prep + legal (DPA) sign-off. Hosted POC without MTLS can be turned up in ~3 business days (sandbox account + test org).

sam-se: On pricing — if they require sustained SCIM bursts >500rpm or delta syncs across 100k users we should move to Dedicated pricing band. I'll prepare two quotes: Hosted (baseline) and Dedicated (performance + compliance).

tara-sales: Great. Also need a short legal one-pager summarizing identity data flow, retention, and responsibilities to attach to their security questionnaire.

olga-sec: I’ll draft the one-pager with a dataflow diagram, retention table, encryption/KMS notes, and SCIM auth modes. Will send by EOD. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: sandbox deploy: all checks passed — no infra blockers for the sandbox env (env-id: sandbox-lumenco-02).

tara-sales: Perfect — I’ll send the docs to the customer and schedule the POC kickoff for Monday. Thanks all :rocket:
